fusions.name: Pommel Struck Home
fusions.desc: Drives the knife in with a blow to the pommel, dealing 14 damage, stunning the target for 1 second and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Flatten the Wound
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up, striking for 9 damage, leaving the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds and 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Fresh From the Anvil
fusions.desc: Increases your critical damage by 35% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Quenched Temper
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
